text:
maria: Quick sync — final checklist before we push the webinar launch post + landing. Focus: keyword targets for the post, JSON-LD (WebinarEvent + FAQPage), internal anchor plan, and redirect behavior for signup. Want this live Thurs evening.

dan: Suggest primary keyword: "inference benchmarks" and secondary: "LLM inference cost". Use derivative longtails in H2s: "real-world inference benchmarks", "reduce per-token cost". Keep keyword density natural.

kevin: For schema I made two small stubs. Put main WebinarEvent JSON-LD in the <head>, and a compact FAQPage block below the fold. These help rich snippets in SERPs.

kevin: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebinarEvent","name":"Redwood Inference: Inference Benchmarks & Launch","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00-04:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},"description":"Demo of benchmark methodology, cost controls, and rollout patterns."}
```

anika: FAQ examples (short Q/A) — these will go into FAQPage JSON-LD and also appear in an on-page accordion. 1) How long is the webinar? ~60 minutes. 2) Who is this for? Engineers and platform teams. 3) Can I get the benchmark data? Yes, link to artifacts.

maria: Redirect decision: marketing wants /webinars/signup -> /pricing/signup?src=webinar (permalink for analytics) as a 302 during the initial 72h test window, then swap to 301. Dev asks we include Cache-Control: no-cache header during the test.

dan: Confirmed. Add a rel=\"canonical\" pointing to /webinar for the blog post, and for the landing page canonical should point to itself (/webinar). Avoid cross-canonicals.

kevin: Internal linking plan: from blog post link to landing with anchor text "benchmark highlights" (#benchmarks), "cost playbook" (#cost-playbook), and to docs: Deployments > Dedicated (contextual link). Add an editorial link from the SDK docs page to the webinar landing to pass authority.

anika: Lead routing: use utm_source=webinar_post and utm_medium=organic where appropriate. Sales ops will map utm_source values to HubSpot queues: webinar_post -> inbound-sdr, webinar_paid -> paid-ops. Also put utm_campaign=launch_may.

sales-ops-bot: Mapping drafted: [webinar_post -> inbound-sdr], [webinar_paid -> paid-ops], [webinar_partner -> partner-referrals], fallback tag: webinar_manual_review. Will email the ops team.

maria: Quick curl checks we should run post-deploy:
```bash
# test redirect behavior and headers
curl -I -L "https://redwood.com/webinars/signup?utm_source=webinar_post"
# expect during test: 302 -> Location: /pricing/signup?src=webinar&utm_source=webinar_post&utm_campaign=launch_may and Cache-Control: no-cache
```

dan: Also test canonical and schema presence:
```bash
curl -s "https://staging.redwood.com/webinar" | grep -A2 "WebinarEvent" # ensure JSON-LD present in head
```

kevin: I'll drop the final JSON-LD and FAQ snippet into the draft by EOD. Anika can upload FAQ copy to the accordion. Maria will sign off on anchors and keywords.

anika: I'll run a quick SERP snippet preview (meta + structured data) and post screenshots.

publish-bot: Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.com/webinar-preview (build-502).

maria: Great — action items: kevin add JSON-LD + FAQ, sales-ops-bot confirm mapping via email, dan add canonical tags and run curl smoke tests, anika prepare snippet screenshots. We'll flip redirect to 301 after 72h if everything looks stable. :white_check_mark:
